kṛśarā कृशरा
Porridge
A food preparation made with rice, green gram, salt, ginger, and asafoetida in appropriate amounts and boiled until the rice becomes soft.

.30 kṛṣṇa-maṇḍalam कृष्णमण्डलम्
Comea and Iris
The part of the eyeball which is black or coloured (in contrast to the white sclera).

ITA-5.41.19 kālamehaḥ/ kṛṣṇamehaḥ कालमेहः/कृष्णमेहः
Polyuria disorder with urine resembling black ink
A disorder characterized by the passage of urine resembling black ink; profuse urination; elimination of urine which is hot in nature.
